_comment: InteropHQ voice node. Built once at install; the startup command runs the binary. Needs TWO allocations: the primary is the control API (FXServer -> node) and a second is the audio stream (players' browsers -> node).
name: InteropHQ Voice Node
author: avery627@gmail.com
description: rfx-voiced - the P25 voice node. Taps each FXServer's built-in Mumble server, runs the vocoder chain, and streams radio audio to game clients. Pulls its server list from InteropHQ when a platform key is set, and falls back to a local servers.json when it is not.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# InteropHQ voice node - install
#
# Runs as root in its own container, which is the only place the build CAN
# happen: `opusic-sys` compiles libopus from source with cmake, and a Pelican
# runtime yolk is unprivileged and ships neither cmake nor a C++ compiler.
#
# The build happens HERE, once, and the startup command just runs the binary.
# Building at startup instead would recompile 180 crates plus libopus on every
# restart - minutes of CPU on a box that is also running game servers, with
# voice down the whole time.

set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Cargo writes to $HOME. Point both at the volume so the registry cache
# survives the container and a reinstall is not a cold download.
export HOME=/mnt/server
export CARGO_HOME=/mnt/server/.cargo

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

BRANCH="${BRANCH:-main}"
SRC=/mnt/server/source

# Source lives in its own directory rather than at the volume root. The root
# also holds the binary, the caches and the runtime data files, and cloning
# into it means "is this directory empty" can never answer the question the
# stock installer asks it.
if [ -d "${SRC}/.git" ]; then
    echo "updating existing checkout"
    cd "${SRC}"
    git fetch --all --prune
    git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
    echo "cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (${BRANCH})"
    rm -rf "${SRC}"
    git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" "${SRC}"
fi

cd "${SRC}/${CRATE_DIR:-.}"

if [ ! -f Cargo.toml ]; then
    echo "no Cargo.toml at ${CRATE_DIR:-.} - check the CRATE_DIR variable"
    exit 1
fi

echo "building rfx-voiced - this is the slow part and it only happens here"
cargo build --release

cp target/release/rfx-voiced /mnt/server/rfx-voiced
chmod +x /mnt/server/rfx-voiced

# Intermediates are several GB and count against the server's disk quota. The
# binary is already copied out, and .cargo is kept so a rebuild is quick.
rm -rf target

echo "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Repository holding the voice node source. HTTPS URL.

variables.name: Crate directory
variables.description: Path to the crate inside the repository. Use . if the repo IS the crate; use resources/[local]/rfx_p25/voiced if you pushed the whole FiveM project.

variables.name: Git username (private repos)
variables.description: Leave blank for a public repository.

variables.name: Git access token (private repos)
variables.description: Personal access token. Leave blank for a public repository.

variables.name: Audio stream port
variables.description: The SECOND allocation, in Network. Players' game clients connect here for audio, so unlike the primary port this one has to be reachable from outside the host.

variables.name: Platform URL
variables.description: InteropHQ, for the server list and heartbeat. Leave blank to run standalone from servers.json.

variables.name: Platform node key
variables.description: NODE_API_KEY from the platform. This is a DIFFERENT principal from a server key - a node leaking must not be a server leaking. Watch for a trailing space; it goes inside the value and 401s.

variables.name: Tap username
variables.description: What the tap calls itself on each FXServer's Mumble server. FiveM names clients [id] name, so this must keep that shape.

variables.name: Codec2 mode
variables.description: 3200 or 2400. 2400 is rate-matched to AMBE+2 half-rate; 3200 is the closer perceptual match to a real Phase 2 radio on a strong signal.

variables.name: Server list cache
variables.description: Last good platform response. The dashboard being down should degrade the platform, not stop it.

variables.name: Local server store
variables.description: Hand-enrolled servers, used when no platform is configured.
